Name: SP_EFFECT_SET_PARAM_ST
Description: Up to four SpEffects given to a character placed by a map. The MSB enemy part has 4 SpEffectSetParam IDs, so a placed character can hold up to 16 SpEffects this way. Each valid SpEffect is applied once when the character is set up; set ID 0 or -1, or a missing row, gives nothing.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [1]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the map-placed character when it is set up (a timed SpEffect is not renewed when it expires). -1: none.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [2]
Fields.Description: Second SpEffect applied to the map-placed character. -1: none.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [3]
Fields.Description: Third SpEffect applied to the map-placed character. -1: none.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [4]
Fields.Description: Fourth SpEffect applied to the map-placed character. -1: none. Unused in retail.
